key.name: idle-timeout-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds of user inactivity before the screensaver activates.

key.name: selected-mode
key.description: Which screensaver mode to display: "blank", "clock", "slideshow", "shader", or "lines".

key.name: lock-on-activate
key.summary: Lock the session when the screensaver activates
key.description: When true, the session is locked via the available D-Bus session-lock interface when the screensaver starts (or immediately after dismissal).

key.name: disable-on-battery
key.summary: Disable screensaver activation on battery power

key.name: disable-when-inhibited
key.description: When true, applications that hold an org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver inhibitor (video players, presentations, games) prevent activation.

key.name: slideshow-directory
key.summary: Directory to source slideshow images from
key.description: Empty string means "not configured"; falls back to XDG_PICTURES_DIR at runtime.

key.name: slideshow-interval-seconds
key.summary: Seconds each slideshow image is displayed

key.name: shader-selection
key.description: Either a built-in shader name ("gradient", "starfield") or an absolute path to a user-supplied .frag file.

key.name: preview-mode
key.summary: Internal flag marking a preview (non-idle-triggered) run
key.description: Not persisted meaningfully across sessions; used to distinguish a live settings-window preview render from a real activation.

key.name: launch-at-login
key.summary: Start the application automatically at login
